decisions.decision: Build Constraints via default and field assignment instead of struct literal
decisions.rationale: Constraints became #[non_exhaustive] in 0.13, so struct literals no longer compile; using default then setting budget matches other call sites and keeps future fields additive.
decisions.quote: `Constraints` is `#[non_exhaustive]` as of 0.13, so it is built from its default and adjusted.

decisions.decision: Remove unused BTreeSet import from pack_exact.rs
decisions.rationale: The BTreeSet import became unused after replacing the struct literal with default construction.

decisions.decision: Add a fuzz-build Makefile target to compile fuzz targets without running them
decisions.rationale: The fuzz workspace is separate and was never compiled by root workspace checks; compiling is cheap and catches breakages.
decisions.quote: `make fuzz-build` compiles the fuzz targets without running them and is now part of `make ci`.

decisions.rationale: CI must see fuzz compilation because local checks passed while the break existed; this makes the gate structural.
decisions.quote: That is the same defect shape as the rest of this cycle — a check that passes without covering what it claims — so the fix is a gate, not just a patch.

decisions.decision: Do not pipe fuzz-build's cargo check through tail
decisions.rationale: A pipeline's exit status is the last command's, so piping through tail would print errors but return 0; the gate must return non-zero on failure.
decisions.quote: Not piped through `tail`. A pipeline's exit status is the last command's, so `cargo check ... | tail -5` prints the error and returns 0 — a gate that reports a failure and passes anyway

decisions.decision: Do not run fuzzers as part of make ci; only compile them
decisions.rationale: Running fuzzers requires nightly and a minute per target, so it remains a separate job; compilation catches the break in seconds.
decisions.quote: Compiling costs a second; *running* the fuzzers needs nightly and a minute per target, which is why that stays its own job.

decisions.decision: Make verify-doc-output.py binary path overridable via SMYSL_BIN
decisions.rationale: This lets the new cargo test pass the binary cargo built for it, so mutation testing exercises the mutated binary rather than a stale one.
decisions.quote: The binary under test. Overridable so `tests/doc_output.rs` can point this at the binary cargo just built for it — `CARGO_BIN_EXE_smysl` — rather than at whatever happens to be in target/debug.

decisions.decision: Fix path extraction in verify-doc-output.py to skip token 0
decisions.rationale: Token 0 is the binary name, not a manual input; if the binary path is absolute, the absolute-path rule would otherwise skip all commands.
decisions.quote: `i` starts at 1: token 0 is the binary this script was told to run, not an input the manual named.

decisions.decision: Add tests/doc_output.rs so cargo test runs the doc output replay
decisions.rationale: The replay script existed but was invisible to cargo test and coverage tools; adding it as an integration test makes it measurable.
decisions.quote: But nothing in `cargo test` invoked it, so nothing that *counts* coverage could see it either.

decisions.decision: Assert on transcript count rather than just MISMATCHED presence in doc output test
decisions.rationale: The first version asserted only that MISMATCHED appeared, which ran 0 transcripts satisfied; the count assertion ensures a gate that cannot confuse nothing wrong with nothing checked.
decisions.quote: So the assertion is on the count. A gate that cannot tell "nothing was wrong" from "nothing was checked" is the failure this repository keeps rediscovering.

decisions.decision: Compile out the doc output test outside the default-ish feature set
decisions.rationale: The script compares against a default-features build; running under other features caused false drift, and a compiled-out test is better than a runtime skip.
decisions.quote: So this runs in exactly one of the eight matrix configurations — the plain `cargo test --workspace` — and is compiled out of the rest.
